name: jenkins-lan-inspector
description: Read-only inspection of LAN Jenkins jobs with mandatory secret redaction.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect Jenkins jobs without exposing inline secrets.
interface.longDescription: Safely reads Jenkins job metadata, config.xml, console-log tails, and workspace listings over the Jenkins HTTP API. All credential-like assignments are redacted and no build-changing operation is included.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the polybot-yellow Jenkins job configuration.
Show the latest redacted console log for a Jenkins job.
List the workspace root for a Jenkins job.
